description: This file contains shell functions related to Git repository management and output formatting, including creating commits, extracting abbreviated object IDs, and processing Git command outputs for user-friendly display.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns each commit's object ID to shell variables supplied as arguments.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Extracts an abbreviated object ID from a full Git object ID, or returns 'undefined-oid' if input is invalid.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats the output of Git commands to be stable and user-friendly by replacing identifiers and locale-specific messages.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters the formatted output, allowing only specific lines based on provided sed expressions.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Reformats input lines, removing prompts and trailing characters, and saves to a file named 'expect'.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares the current state of references with expected output, optionally working within a directory context.
